title: P0300 – Random/Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected
description: The PCM detected random or multiple cylinder misfires. A flashing check engine light means catalytic converter damage risk—reduce load immediately.
urgencyNote: If the light is flashing, stop hard acceleration and diagnose soon to protect the catalytic converter.
symptoms: Flashing or steady check engine light
causes: Worn spark plugs or ignition coils
solutions: Note freeze-frame RPM/load when misfire set
Check for companion P0301–P0308 cylinder codes
Inspect plugs, coils, and plug wires; swap coils to isolate
Smoke-test for vacuum leaks; verify fuel pressure
Compression/leak-down if ignition and fuel check out

faq.question: Is a flashing check engine light with P0300 serious?
faq.answer: Yes. It usually means active misfire that can overheat and destroy the catalytic converter. Ease off and diagnose promptly.

faq.question: Can bad gas cause P0300?
faq.answer: Contaminated or very low fuel can contribute, but plugs, coils, and vacuum leaks are more common first checks.
